description: Queues a public, read-only, credential-free API for probing, from a target object { name, spec_url (OpenAPI 3 document), category?, include_paths?, baseline? (valid values for required params per path), optional_values?, server? }. The spec is fetched and parsed and the battery planned immediately; probing runs rules-only on the worker's next pass. Requires a per-user key; quota 3 requests per key per day. Returns a request id for get_request_status.

target.description: the target definition; see targets/*.json in the repo for examples

name: request_target
title: Request a target
